task_description: Make the Appian MQTT connected system plug-in AppMarket-compliant for Appian 26.9: rename the reserved root package com.appian.mqtt to de.hock.mqtt everywhere, fix the plug-in manifest (key, vendor, application-version min 26.9.0.0, new class FQNs), and fix the packaging so the shipped assembly jar contains its own .java sources beside the .class files plus Paho under META-INF/lib, then sweep for Appian plug-in policy violations and fix the invalidated docs.
